entries.prompt: Photoreal architectural material concept for a compact restroom inside the same SYNK adult language academy. A believable small rectangular room approximately 2.15 m wide by 2.475 m deep, one toilet and one small washbasin only, clearly usable uncluttered floor between entrance and fixtures. View just inside its side entrance, eye-level 28mm architectural lens, straight verticals, no exaggerated space. One simple white close-coupled toilet with visible cistern, credible plumbing and service access, white ceiling and discreet exhaust grille. Toilet and washbasin placed SIDE BY SIDE along the far plumbing wall, basin at far RIGHT end, toilet at far LEFT end; don't block the toilet with the vanity. Leave the middle and foreground empty, sliding entry door edge at left side, no door swing through fixtures. Include soap dispenser, hand-towel dispenser beside basin, toilet paper holder next to toilet, small covered waste bin; no clutter. Calm refined everyday adult academy, modest construction, same design language as white walls/oak/grey floors elsewhere. Do not mirror duplicate fixtures. This is an atmosphere concept, not dimension drawing. Men's single-user restroom interior. A small sanitary covered bin at side, no urinal. Compose the scene with floor, toilet and basin all fully visible, slightly diagonal doorway viewpoint.
